item.title: Middling McIlroy makes little noise
item.description: Nursing a bad back coming into the Players Championship, Rory McIlroy found himself fighting to make the cut Friday at TPC Sawgrass.

item.title: Scheffler is caught in the grind
item.description: Scottie Scheffler found himself in unfamiliar territory Saturday at TPC Sawgrass, beginning his Players Championship round at 9.25 a.m., 70 minutes after play started and more than five hours before the leader, Ludvig Åberg, was to tee off.

item.title: Åberg is primed for his big moment
item.description: There has been a sense for a while now that Ludvig Åberg’s big moment was not far away. It has never been closer than Sunday when he takes a three-shot into the final round of the Players Championship.

item.title: Ranking the winners and losers at Players
item.description: PONTE VEDRA BEACH, FLORIDA | It took longer than anyone expected for Cameron Young to win on tour and show his mettle in a Ryder Cup. But once that seal was broken starting last August in Greensboro in the shadow of his Wake Forest alma mater, Young has hit his stride. Young’s biggest-moment countdown was as easy as T7 (Riviera) … T3 (Bay Hill) … 1 (TPC Sawgrass). item.title: Young has goods to challenge Scottie and Rory
item.description: There had been a sense of inevitability around Players Championship winner Cameron Young for a while, a waiting-for-the-moment anticipation that went deeper than the eye test. Read Green In Regulation for more.

item.title: ‘Mountain-reaching heaven’
item.description: Mauna Lani, a Hawaiian resort with two 18-hole courses, has recently undergone a $280 million restoration that allows it to live up to its name, which translates from the Hawaiian language to “mountain-reaching heaven.”

item.title: Labor land mine
item.description: In an effort to protect a key source of labor for golf clubs across the country, the golf industry is joining others representing hospitality interests in pushing the Trump administration to make targeted alterations to the H-2B visa program. Our Daniel Polce has the story.
